en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a bustling outdoor market or fair. Numerous horse-drawn wagons line both sides of a wide dirt street, with many people in early‑20th‑century clothing walking or gathered in groups. Large leafy trees surround the scene, and in the background there appears to be a white church or large building with a gabled roof and a fenced entrance. The corners of the image are rounded, and there is a small handwritten "I" in the upper right margin. No printed caption is visible.
